Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL1824. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Filter target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is present. Return DISTINCT rows for compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
